hypotheses.P0_path_sum_is_exact: All 81 MLP derivative path types recompose the analytic attention-frozen Jacobian with maximum relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.P1_frozen_16_path_program_is_sufficient: The discovery-frozen 16-path program has aggregate Jacobian fidelity at least 0.80 on every evaluation corpus.
hypotheses.P2_frozen_32_path_program_is_high_fideli: The discovery-frozen 32-path program has aggregate Jacobian fidelity at least 0.90 on every evaluation corpus.
hypotheses.P3_frozen_paths_beat_random: At budget 16, the frozen program exceeds the matched random-subset 95th percentile by at least 0.10 on every corpus.
hypotheses.P4_path_program_transfers_ood: Frozen-path fidelity at budget 16 on each OOD corpus is within 0.05 of disjoint FineWeb.
hypotheses.P5_one_path_is_not_enough: No corpus has frozen one-path fidelity above 0.80.
hypotheses.P6_context_specific_selection_is_materia: At budget 16, the per-example oracle exceeds the frozen program by at least 0.05 on at least one corpus.
hypotheses.P7_bilinear_path_types_are_material: At least half of the frozen top-16 paths contain a left or right bilinear arm in two or more layers.
hypotheses.P8_program_predicts_finite_effects: The frozen 32-path tangent predicts the finite attention-frozen MLP-path intervention with fidelity at least 0.85 on every corpus.
